Class Car

java.lang.Object
edu.valencia.cardms.Car
public class Car extends Object
Represents a car in the Car Data Management System. Stores car information such as ID, make, model, year, price, mileage, and color. This class also validates car information before it is stored or updated in the system.

    • Car

      public Car(int id, String make, String model, int year, double price, int mileage, String color)
      Creates a car with the provided information. All values are validated before being assigned.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique car ID
      make - the car manufacturer
      model - the car model
      year - the manufacturing year
      price - the car price
      mileage - the car mileage
      color - the car color
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any car information is invalid
